verdict.rationale: Substantive text was captured from multiple public guidance pages on www.dpma.de (home, trade mark and patent application, e-filing). That implies the guidance surface serves readable content without a login, CAPTCHA, or JS-only shell. However, there is no explicit probe of those pages recording status codes or the user agent. The only probe covers the separate register.dpma.de search host, whose robots.txt disallows all crawling; that restricts the database surface, not the guidance pages. Missing for 10: an explicit fetch probe of the www.dpma.de guidance pages with an identified UA showing HTTP 200, confirmation that no bot wall or CAPTCHA is in front of them, and a www.dpma.de robots.txt check.
